description: A searchable single-choice picker that renders a Combobox on desktop and a search drawer on mobile.
overview:
`SearchPicker` lets the user find and choose one item from a long list. On desktop it renders a suiss/ui `Combobox`: the field itself is the search input, and the list filters as the user types. On mobile (below `48rem`, via `useIsMobile`) it renders a field-style button that shows the selected label. Tapping it opens a `Drawer` with a swipe handle and a `Command` menu whose search input receives focus. Choosing an item closes the drawer.

Items are passed as data. When any item has a `group`, items are listed under group headings in both presentations. Use it for countries, cities, users and other lists too long to scan; for short lists, use `Picker`.
usage:
- Each item in `items` has a `value`, a `label`, and an optional `group` and `disabled` flag. The `SearchPickerItem` type is exported.
- The value is uncontrolled by default; use `defaultValue`, or `value` with `onValueChange` to control it. The value is `null` when nothing is selected.
- `searchPlaceholder`, `title`, `floating`, `showCloseButton` and `closeLabel` affect only the mobile drawer. On desktop the field shows `placeholder`.
- Mobile search matches against each item's label.

examples.WithValue: Starts with a selected item through `defaultValue`.
examples.Grouped: Lists cities under group headings and filters across groups.
examples.WithTitle: Shows a visible title at the top of the mobile drawer.
examples.WithCloseButton: Adds a close button to the mobile drawer.
examples.WithCloseLabel: Uses a Cancel text button for the mobile close button.
examples.Controlled: Owns the value in state with `value` and `onValueChange`.
examples.Floating: Insets the mobile drawer from the screen edges.

parts.SearchPicker: The complete searchable picker, rendered from the `items` array.

SearchPicker.items: The items to choose from, each with a `value`, `label`, and optional `group` and `disabled`.
SearchPicker.value: The selected value when controlled, or `null` for no selection.
SearchPicker.defaultValue: The initially selected value when uncontrolled.
SearchPicker.onValueChange: Called with the new value, or `null`, when the selection changes.
SearchPicker.placeholder: Text shown when nothing is selected.
SearchPicker.searchPlaceholder: Placeholder of the search input in the mobile drawer.
SearchPicker.emptyText: Text shown when no item matches the search.
SearchPicker.title: A visible heading for the mobile drawer. When omitted, the drawer title is visually hidden and falls back to `placeholder` or `aria-label`.
SearchPicker.floating: Insets the mobile drawer from the screen edges.
SearchPicker.showCloseButton: Shows a close button in the mobile drawer.
SearchPicker.closeLabel: Text for the mobile close button in place of the icon.
SearchPicker.id: The ID of the input on desktop or the trigger button on mobile.
SearchPicker.className: Classes applied to the input on desktop or the trigger button on mobile.
SearchPicker.aria-invalid: Marks the field as invalid and applies the error style.
SearchPicker.aria-label: The accessible name of the field.
SearchPicker.aria-describedby: The ID of an element that describes the field.

accessibility:
- On desktop the field has the `combobox` role and controls a `listbox`. The selected option has `aria-selected`, disabled options have `aria-disabled`, and groups are exposed as `group` elements named by their heading.
- Escape closes the desktop list.
- On mobile, the drawer is titled by `title`, `placeholder` or `aria-label`, and focus moves to the search input when it opens.
notes: Styling hooks: `data-slot="search-picker"`, `search-picker-trigger` (mobile) and `search-picker-content`. The mobile trigger has `data-placeholder` while nothing is selected, and the selected command item has `data-checked`.
